the_refusals_are_the_deliverable: build_index refuses a missing task, a task at zero items, a wrong split, a limit, and -- the one none of the others can see -- a task that merely came back SHORT. The Hub is read unauthenticated here (trap_4 below), so a rate-limited split returns fewer items rather than failing; without EXPECTED_ITEMS a truncated index would be built, marked complete, digested and used while its own provenance asserted the opposite. coverage_problems re-asks all of it of a frozen file later, when a task may have been added or a split grown.
